author: UmbreonMessiah
body:
After about 3 months and the last 16 hours of my life spent hand-building this map, I am proud to finally present to you, people of Avicus, my least ugly map! Also known as Suspended - CTW.

Essentials:
Images: http://imgur.com/a/DUoUP
YML: (Will have ready in morning!)
Download: (Am going to put up at same time as YML.)
                                                                                              
Info:
15v15 (Map may seem too small for this, can give reasoning behind player count on request)
As a CTW map, I feel it should be based around speed and agility. This map has that, with a narrow(ish) bridge providing lots of PVP room, a large emphasis on vertical movement, and a tight tunnel for sneaky-ninja skills and face-face PVP showdowns. Or, if you're the more boring type of person, I left you some void to bridge across.
Expected Difficulty: 7/10.
This map is small, and is designed to be difficult. However, it really depends on the teams. A sneaky-ninja against some blind little Steve bats will thrive in this environment, while their MLG-FaZe Clan friends go own newbs with the one set of diamond armor given to each team. However, if a team does not consist of blind Steve bats, then this map is going to be difficult. Getting to the wool room will be a matter of how strong your YOLO is, (I even provided you a Yolo'd sword, Sharpness II Iron sword.) But getting out will be difficult, considering how easy this map is to defend on. If you don't work as a team, and walk like you got hit with a slowness potion, then you will break many, many items while playing this map.                                                                                                                         Aesthetics:
This map was really based more around what I wanted to play it like. So I went with a simple Aesthetic that I think ended up working well, it looks nice, but doesn't distract you and DOES NOT get in your way just because I want it to look pretty.   
Loadout:
Leather_Helmet (Dyed) Leather_Tunic (Dyed) Iron_Leggings, Leather_Boots (Dyed)
Iron_Sword, Bow (Infinity I), Diamond_Pickaxe, Gold_Apple (3), Steak (32),Oak_Logs (16)
Arrow (1)
Edit: I forgot to mention that this map was not intended for you to be able to dig right under the round, so I made it so that in most places you can only barely dig under the surface. I don't want it to be THAT map. (If you know what I mean) And the underside of the islands kind of has a ring going around them, to give you an option where you actually use your pickaxe. YML and Download coming up soon, updating map with suggestions.

This is my second map, after my first one (admittedly) sucked alot. Trust me, this one is much better and I'm really happy with it. This is, however, my first map of this gamemode and style. I'd be glad to answer any questions, and feedback is always appreciated. 

Changelog:
Version: 1.0
Added: Everything
Removed: N/A

replies.author: Lakitue
replies.body:
Im having issues with the wool rooms, doe I understand why you did these kind of rooms.
Too improve these wool rooms you can do either:
Make a circle of bedrock around the room, by doing this players won't be able to mine into the rooms. The rooms also need to be bigger, even doe the map is small these rooms are waaaay too small, what if 4 people get in at the same time? There will be no space at all!

Otherwise if you don't find a way to improve the wool rooms you got atm, I'd suggest you to make a path, one on the right and one on the left that would lead you too the new wool rooms. 1st people would be able to make decent defences along the paths and it would just make more sense (imo).

If you don't understand what I mean, go ahead and add me on skype, robin_dd_j
